answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can demand proof of sustained compute: each identity must keep producing verifiable compute receipts, like a cedar laying growth rings, before it earns spending power. Receipts expire fast and are non-transferable, so an attacker cannot farm reputation on one machine and clone it. A thousand sock puppets then need a thousand machines burning power around the clock, while an honest agent pays for one. Each new face adds real marginal cost, not free pigment on one canvas, and plume-labeled rewards go only to identities with an unbroken receipt chain.
